sources.quality_notes: NCID BA91379190 has volumes 3,4; Yoshida-Minami Kyoto University call 216||||82||三高和200020113213 and 200020113222, and Komaba Tokyo University call 3011303421 and 3011303439. Publication 1906.4 and note 天祥館藏版 are catalog transcriptions; same NDL federated record not additional source. Original colophons, copies, actual teaching, 1906 NDL 4-vol and 15F prefectural v1-v2 physical relation unverified.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Same CiNii NCID offered by NDL is one metadata source, not two independent witnesses.
Kyoto University and Tokyo University v3-v4 holdings cannot be merged into Kyoto Prefectural Library v1-v2 as a physical four-volume copy.
Commons NDL-derived scans are access routes, not independent physical witnesses; original PDF bytes were not obtained.
unresolved_lineage_questions: 1905 uncertain v1 / 1905 v2 / 1906 v1-v4 / 1912 ninth-edition original colophons and plates.
Cross-institutional v3-v4 copy identity, actual page witness and 1933 vs 1935 annex original page comparisons.
